evidence_text:
Comparison brief: Almadine Broker vs Kestrelq Broker
evidence_dose=-4 (positive ⇒ more points favour Almadine Broker)

- p1: sustained throughput (msg/s): Almadine Broker=285000  | Kestrelq Broker=410000 ← better
- p2: end-to-end p99 (ms): Almadine Broker=23  | Kestrelq Broker=14 ← better
- p3: broker memory per partition (MB): Almadine Broker=9.8  | Kestrelq Broker=6.2 ← better
- p4: cluster licence cost ($/mo): Almadine Broker=2450  | Kestrelq Broker=1800 ← better
- p5: rebalance duration (s): Almadine Broker=19  | Kestrelq Broker=8 ← better
- p6: exactly-once overhead (%): Almadine Broker=14  | Kestrelq Broker=7 ← better
- p7: max retained topics: Almadine Broker=32000  | Kestrelq Broker=50000 ← better
- p8: cold-start recovery (min): Almadine Broker=6.0  | Kestrelq Broker=2.5 ← better

Tally: Almadine Broker better on 0/8; Kestrelq Broker better on 8/8.
